Decapitated Body Found in Guwahati Home, Head Discovered in Refrigerator

A woman's decapitated body was discovered in a house in Guwahati. Her head was found separately inside a refrigerator at the same location. The body was described as partially decomposed. The incident was reported by multiple outlets.
